Item:Dolorous Flames (heroic)

From DDO wiki
Jump to navigation Jump to search

Dolorous Flames

Minimum Level 8

Rarity Named
Bind status Bound to Account on Acquire
Augment Type Lamordia: Dolorous (Weapon)
Description Slotted Effect: Adds Good alignment bypass and Flaming. This effect causes the edges of this weapon to burn with enchanted flames, dealing 6d6 Fire damage on each critical hit.
Base Value 500pp
Weight 0.01 lbs
Locations

  • Heroic Viktranium Experiment Crafting, Ludendorf City Hall
Enhancements
  • Good AlignedGood Aligned: This weapon transmutes into a form that is able to bypass Good alignment based Damage Reduction.
  • Flaming 6Flaming 6: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to burn with enchanted flames, dealing 6d66 to 36 Fire damage on each critical hit.
